event_entry_type.description: The entry type used for events.

event_date.description: The date field that holds the event's date.

send_at.description: The time of day, the day after the event, when the recap and messages are drafted (workspace time zone).

rsvp_type.description: The entry type used for RSVPs, one per guest and published once confirmed.

rsvp_event_field.description: The field on an RSVP that names its event (the last part of the event's web address).

draft_entry_type.description: The entry type each note is drafted as.

draft_body_field.description: The text field on that entry type where the note goes.
